description: Ministry of Justice - Order under Mediation (Special categories of Disputes) Act, that each Administration District of Mullaitivu, Vavuniya, Mannar & Ampara as special Mediation Board Areas
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that specifies a Special Mediation Board Area under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003. It involves the exercise of statutory powers by the Minister of Justice to designate administrative districts for special mediation procedures related to land disputes, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes.
